task.description: WF-03 Step 2b hard gate on CODE-DESIGNER's design for ISS-0724.
acceptance_criteria: sort_order computation verified behavior-preserving by hand trace
AC1's compile-failure claim checked for overclaiming

result.summary: AC1/AC2 coverage confirmed sound, sort_order hand-traced (3 random + 2 manual) and confirmed bit-for-bit identical to current behavior -- both PASS. HARD FAIL on implementation-code-in-design: section 2 step 3 (lines 62-67) is a literal pasteable Elixir pipeline (Enum.with_index/Map.put), section 2 step 4 (lines 86-97) reproduces the full with/do block verbatim, section 3 (lines 136-141) gives a complete pasteable persist_session_questions/5 body -- contrast with the iss0722 design doc's own discipline of describing bodies in prose ('Body, in words: ...'), reserving code fences only for quoting already-shipped code. Also: section 4's claim that no fallback merge path exists is overstated -- a future edit could pass a merged/reshuffled list as one arg and [] as the other, satisfying the new 5-arity signature while still compiling and silently violating the invariant; the design needs to name this residual gap explicitly and point to the assertion-level backstop (AC1's 'or fail an obvious assertion' clause) rather than implying the arity change alone closes the door.

issues.description: Design doc contains full implementation code in sections 2 and 3 instead of @specs + prose. Must be rewritten to prose-only per this project's design-doc convention (iss0722 doc as the model).

Section 4 overclaims the compile-failure guarantee -- does not address the merged-list-plus-empty-second-arg regression path, which still compiles under the new 5-arity signature. Must name this gap and cite the assertion-level backstop explicitly.

result.next_action: Rework 1: CODE-DESIGNER rewrites sections 2/3 to prose-only (no pasteable Elixir), and corrects section 4's compile-failure claim to name the residual merged-list-plus-empty-arg gap and its assertion-level backstop.
